issues.title: V552J fabricates an `unknown` primary object when no evidence exists
issues.defect: When neither a V552 temporal key nor packet bundle is available, current code can synthesize a row with `packet_id=v552j__<run_id>` and `source=unknown`.
issues.evidence: Identified in hostile pass of current V552J handoff.
issues.consequence: Absence becomes a fake empirical object that can flow downstream as if observed.
issues.required: Emit zero primary rows with a typed no-evidence manifest/state. Never invent `unknown` source/packet identity.
tests: No V552 + no packet input → 0 handoff rows, integrity PASS, typed absence.

issues.title: V552J turns absence of constraints into numeric zero scores
issues.defect: Mean certification/support/directionality/authority/comparability/confidence/readiness scores default to 0.0 when there are no constraints.
issues.consequence: `no observations` is encoded as `observed worst score`, recreating the missing→zero error at a later stage.
issues.required: Use null numeric values plus explicit constraint/evidence status when count is zero.

issues.title: `_first_nonempty` is defined twice
issues.defect: The helper exists twice with different signatures; the later definition shadows the earlier one.
issues.evidence: AST duplicate-function scan during hostile pass.
issues.consequence: Dead/shadow code makes behavior sensitive to definition order and encourages edits to the wrong implementation.
issues.required: Consolidate to one helper after semantic repair is green.
